paragraphs.zh: -    transgene Kulturpflanzen, welche gegen bestimmte Herbizide vom Typ Glufosinate (vgl. z. B. EP-A-0242236, EP-A-242246) oder Glyphosate (WO 92/00377) oder der Sulfonylharnstoffe (EP-A-0257993, US-A-5013659) resistent sind,
paragraphs.en: -    transgenic crop plants which are resistant to certain herbicides of the glufosinate type (cf. e.g. EP-A-0242236, EP-A-242246) or glyphosate (WO 92/00377) or the sulfonylureas (EP-A-0257993, US-A-5013659),
paragraphs.notes: Second item of a dash-bulleted list that begins on the preceding page; the page opens mid-list with no lead-in sentence. The printed bullet is a plain hyphen in the left margin, recorded here as the marker and repeated at the head of the transcription. Note the printed inconsistency in the two EP numbers: 'EP-A-0242236' carries the leading zero, 'EP-A-242246' does not; transcribed as printed. A small stray ink squiggle sits just below the '5' and '0' of 'US-A-5013659' on the third line; it is a scan artifact, not a character. The item ends on a comma, the list continuing in the next item.

paragraphs.zh: -    transgene Kulturpflanzen, beispielsweise Baumwolle, mit der Fähigkeit Bacillus thuringiensis-Toxine (Bt-Toxine) zu produzieren, welche die Pflanzen gegen bestimmte Schädlinge resistent machen (EP-A-0142924, EP-A-0193259).
paragraphs.en: -    transgenic crop plants, for example cotton, with the ability to produce Bacillus thuringiensis toxins (Bt toxins) which make the plants resistant to certain pests (EP-A-0142924, EP-A-0193259).
paragraphs.notes: Third item of the dash-bulleted list. Printed bullet is a plain hyphen in the left margin. 'Bacillus thuringiensis-Toxine' is printed with a hyphen joining the species name to 'Toxine'; the English rendering drops it as an English compound would.

paragraphs.en: -    transgenic crop plants with a modified fatty acid composition (WO 91/13972).
paragraphs.notes: Fourth and last item of the dash-bulleted list; the list ends here and ordinary prose resumes below. Printed bullet is a plain hyphen in the left margin.

paragraphs.zh: Zahlreiche molekularbiologische Techniken, mit denen neue transgene Pflanzen mit veränderten Eigenschaften hergestellt werden können, sind im Prinzip bekannt; siehe z.B. Sambrook et al., 1989, Molecular Cloning, A Laboratory Manual, 2. Aufl. Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press, Cold Spring Harbor, NY; oder Winnacker "Gene und Klone", VCH Weinheim 2. Auflage 1996 oder Christou, "Trends in Plant Science" 1 (1996) 423-431).
paragraphs.en: Numerous molecular-biological techniques with which new transgenic plants having altered properties can be produced are known in principle; see e.g. Sambrook et al., 1989, Molecular Cloning, A Laboratory Manual, 2nd edn. Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press, Cold Spring Harbor, NY; or Winnacker "Gene und Klone", VCH Weinheim 2nd edition 1996 or Christou, "Trends in Plant Science" 1 (1996) 423-431).
paragraphs.notes: The literature citations are transcribed as printed and are not translated: 'Molecular Cloning, A Laboratory Manual', 'Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press', 'Gene und Klone' and 'Trends in Plant Science' are title and publisher names. 'Aufl.' is the abbreviation of 'Auflage' (edition). The quotation marks around the two titles are printed as straight typewriter double quotes, not German low-high quotes. The sentence carries an unbalanced closing parenthesis after '423-431' with no matching opening parenthesis; printed that way and transcribed as printed. The page number range is printed with a short hyphen-like dash.

paragraphs.zh: Für derartige gentechnische Manipulationen können  Nucleinsäuremoleküle in Plasmide eingebracht werden, die eine Mutagenese oder eine Sequenzveränderung durch Rekombination von DNA-Sequenzen erlauben.  Mit Hilfe der obengenannten Standardverfahren können z. B. Basenaustausche vorgenommen, Teilsequenzen entfernt oder natürliche oder synthetische Sequenzen hinzugefügt werden.  Für die Verbindung der DNA-Fragmente untereinander können an die Fragmente Adaptoren oder Linker angesetzt werden.
paragraphs.en: For genetic manipulations of this kind, nucleic acid molecules can be introduced into plasmids which permit mutagenesis or a sequence alteration by recombination of DNA sequences. With the aid of the abovementioned standard procedures, base exchanges can for example be carried out, part-sequences removed or natural or synthetic sequences added. To join the DNA fragments to one another, adaptors or linkers can be attached to the fragments.
paragraphs.notes: The double space in 'können  Nucleinsäuremoleküle' and the double spaces after 'erlauben.' and 'werden.' are as printed. The German spelling 'Nucleinsäuremoleküle' with a c is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Die Herstellung von Pflanzenzellen mit einer verringerten Aktivität eines Genprodukts kann beispielsweise erzielt werden durch die Expression mindestens einer entsprechenden antisense-RNA, einer sense-RNA zur Erzielung eines Cosuppressionseffektes oder die Expression mindestens eines entsprechend konstruierten Ribozyms, das spezifisch Transkripte des obengenannten Genprodukts spaltet.
paragraphs.en: The production of plant cells with a reduced activity of a gene product can be achieved for example by the expression of at least one corresponding antisense RNA, a sense RNA to bring about a cosuppression effect, or the expression of at least one suitably constructed ribozyme which specifically cleaves transcripts of the abovementioned gene product.
paragraphs.notes: Last paragraph on the page; the lower third of the page below it is blank. 'antisense-RNA' and 'sense-RNA' are printed lower case with a hyphen before RNA.
